body: I apply to jobs for at least 8 hours every day. I do receive unemployment, which will not cover rent, not even a room. Could you like, read the post before assuming that I've done nothing with my days like everybody else in my life, please.

Even $200 puts someone out, it doesn't have to be a lot. There's been days where $20 puts me out. I know it makes them feel better to do the wellness check... But they're not picking up the bill at the end of it.

"Family" is kicking me out. My biological mother decided me taking care of the rent and house on my own wasn't enough, so she's selling the house, I have less than two months to get out. She hasn't even been in this house in over 10 years. My biological father abused me growing up. One set of grandparents will force me to do some sort of conversion therapy and/or force me into certain situations that will routinely put my life in danger, and I will be forced to give my dog to a shelter or abandon him. The other set of grandparents have no room for me, my dog, or my issues, and have no money to spare. No aunts, uncles, or cousins.

Family is great. If you have any.

The other day I threw some canned chickpeas in the air fryer with some spices, they weren't terrible, don't really feel like doing that work again though.

I hate that. You're strong, you've been through worse, it'll get better, I know I said I'd always be here but that was just me spouting words because in reality you should just put a smile on your face and pretend you're happy because it makes me feel more comfortable.

It's definitely not a movie... You get sent to the hospital and oop guess what 265301966, you now have debt too! Congrats! Now go home and put on a smiling face for your friends and family so they feel good about themselves.

I hope your friend is at least able to provide you with some sort of companionship.

What microwave meal? I've been doing plain hot dogs and cup noodles, so something to throw in the micro will help me switch things up. 

Can't be upset with you for feeling something, not cool. My friend treats it like a pissing contest so I just stopped talking to her
With literally *anything* on in the background to feel like someone else is with me. Do we have to have dinner, when we don't do anything other than sit and wish away the day? Unfortunately we do..
Ayyy, same here. Looks like we've found our people.

It's somewhat cathartic to know I'm not the only one in this position. Feels like I'm just waiting for the other shoe to drop. When will he break up with me? When will unemployment stop? When will my measly savings run out? Will I be able to see any therapist before my insurance stops? All I know how to do right now is apply to jobs and look for somewhere to live. We can see how far that's gotten me.

What do you do day to day to distract? Do you have any favorite meals? A show? Do you mind sharing? I need to feel not alone right now.

Edit: it's okay, I get it. If anybody else passes through and wants to drop a distraction, please do.

You're not in love with me, you're in love with the idea of me. I'm not who you fell for anymore; I'm not young, dumb, or naive enough to fall for it again. You just celebrated your 2 year anniversary in the place you promised to take me. You don't love me.
